body.name: boundaryCov
body.def: For \(g_{\beta}(z)=z^{\mathsf T}G_{\infty}(\beta)z\) and \(\psi_{a,\beta}(z)=z^{\mathsf T}D_{\rho_a}G_{\infty}(\beta)z\), \(\mathcal C_{ab}(\beta,u)\) is the continuous coarea version of \(\operatorname{Cov}\{\psi_{a,\beta}(Z),\psi_{b,\beta}(Z)\mid g_{\beta}(Z)=u\}\): each conditional raw moment is the ratio \[\frac{\int_{g_{\beta}^{-1}(u)}h(z)\varphi_{Fp}(z)\lVert\nabla_z g_{\beta}(z)\rVert^{-1}d\mathcal H^{Fp-1}(z)}{\int_{g_{\beta}^{-1}(u)}\varphi_{Fp}(z)\lVert\nabla_z g_{\beta}(z)\rVert^{-1}d\mathcal H^{Fp-1}(z)},\] with \(h=\psi_{a,\beta}\psi_{b,\beta},\psi_{a,\beta},\psi_{b,\beta}\), and covariance is the first ratio minus the product of the latter two ratios; values at removable chart points use the unique continuous extension.
